BiblicalUsage: Periy is fruit, the yield of a tree, a vine, or a life. God commands the earth to bring forth fruit trees at the beginning, and the blessed man is like a tree planted by rivers of water, bringing forth his fruit in his season. The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and the LORD says He searches the heart to give every man according to the fruit of his doings.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe fruit is God's measure of a life: not the leaves or the noise, but what it actually produces. A life planted by His water bears fruit in season, and that fruit feeds others and wins souls. And I hold that the same word warns me too, because God reads the fruit of my doings and repays accordingly.
